about: Executor's sweep after the final blind review, applying two rules to every general pool verse: (1) remove any verse whose plain reading to a suicidal reader is death, the afterlife, rest, the end, going to peace, 'it is better after', seeing someone again or ease of the way; (2) remove any verse, or the theme that reaches it, that tells a reader to forgive, be patient with, submit to or bear with someone who harms them, unless only the forgiveness theme reaches it (whose phrases now need the visitor to want to forgive or to be forgiven). Also: the Bible marriage theme keeps only verses that speak to either spouse.
